# APIGW HEADER KNOWLEDGE BASE

## OVERVIEW

`apigw/header` defines API Gateway header contracts and helper utilities.

## WHERE TO LOOK

- Header constants and helper APIs: `pkg/thirdparty/apigw/header/header.go`

## CONVENTIONS

- Keep APIGW header schema and naming centralized.

## ANTI-PATTERNS

- Do not inline APIGW header literals throughout business code.
